texts.zh:
我们的翻译子个体在解码从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们的调查也确认了我们的猜测：[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]（现在我们所知的正确叫法）完全缺失任何集体智能，并且是由可以独立思考的个体出于某种我们无法恰当理解的原因组织到一起，并自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]。

由个体构成的高等级文明的发现引导我们思考了许多关于宇宙本质的假设。我们分配我们当中了不小的份额来调查他们到底如何发展并且克服根植于缺失如我们所知的集体智能导致缺陷的。
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them on a sufficient level to open diplomatic channels with them. Their investigations have confirmed what we suspected: the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] (as we now know them to be properly called) completely lacks any sort of collective intelligence, and is instead made up of independent-thinking individuals who - for reasons we don't properly understand yet - choose to organize themselves into what they call a [This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName].

The discovery of a highly advanced civilization of individuals has led us to question many of our assumptions about the nature of the universe. We have devoted a not-insignificant part of ourselves to investigating how they developed and how they overcome the challenges inherent to the lack of a collective consciousness as we know it.

texts.zh:
我们的翻译子个体在解码从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们的调查也确认了我们的猜测：[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]（现在我们所知的正确叫法）完全缺失任何集体智能，并且是由可以独立思考的个体出于某种我们无法恰当理解的原因组织到一起，并自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]。

虽然[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName]的个体看起来非常美味，并且我们迫切地想要吞噬他们，但我们还是分配我们当中了不小的份额来调查他们到底如何发展并且克服根植于缺失如我们所知的集体智能导致缺陷的。
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them on a sufficient level to open diplomatic channels with them. Their investigations have confirmed what we suspected: the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] (as we now know them to be properly called) completely lacks any sort of collective intelligence, and is instead made up of independent-thinking individuals who - for reasons we don't properly understand yet - choose to organize themselves into what they call a [This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName].

Although the individual [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName] seems quite tasty, and we eagerly anticipate devouring them, we have devoted a not-insignificant part of ourselves to investigating how they developed and how they overcome the challenges inherent to the lack of a collective consciousness as we know it.

texts.zh:
我们在与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的交流中取得了突破性进展。当我们理解到这些个体如何将其庞杂的社会结构归纳为少量抽象群体——这与我们自身的生物群落、种群和支系并无本质不同——便意识到如何与这些[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]达成更深入的共识。

尽管意识尺度上的巨大差异仍使外交充满挑战，但我们有望通过这些[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所栖居的社会架构实现协调，他们称之为"[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]"。我们将持续关注此类社会建构带来的深远影响——尽管从我们行星文明的视角来看，它们既陌生又充满混沌。
texts.en:
We have made a triumphant breakthrough in our efforts to communicate with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Once we learned how these myriad individuals formed their society into a smaller number of abstract groups - not too dissimilar from our own biomes, packs, and clades - we realized how we might reach better accord with these [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

The vast differences in scale between our consciousnesses still makes diplomacy a challenging prospect, but we may reach accord with the organizations these [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] dwell under, in what they call a '[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]'. We shall continue to marvel at the ramifications of social constructs such as these - alien and chaotic though they may appear from our own planetary perspective.
